Lina: Heads-up: onboarding flow tripped a bunch of 429s this AM. Seeing it on both web + mobile users.
Lina: Starter app does cursor pagination + background prefetch of next 8 cards to make scroll instant.
Lina: Sample response headers: X-RI-Quota: 2/60, X-RI-Reset: 50, Retry-After: 3
Omar (sdk): Which SDKs/versions? We changed prefetch defaults in go-sdk last month, might have drifted across libs.
Lina: Web uses js-sdk v1.5.4, backend prefetch worker uses python-sdk v1.6.8, some customers using go-sdk v0.8.0.
Priya (devex): Repro: open onboarding, scroll quickly, app fires off 6 parallel cursor requests + 2 background embed calls. If token is close to expiry we sometimes see parallel refresh attempts.
Ruth (platform): Logs show multiple concurrent refresh attempts for the same credential id, then a retry burst that consumed the tiny trial quota. This matches the classic thundering-retry pattern.
Omar (sdk): Parity note: JS coalesces refresh; python & go didn't in async prefetch paths. We'll need a per-credential refresh lock across async codepaths.
Omar (sdk): Quick mitigation we can ship: 1) auth coalescing (mutex keyed by cred_id), 2) Respect Retry-After exactly before retrying, 3) Add quota-aware conservative mode (when X-RI-Quota remaining <=3 set concurrency=1 and disable background prefetch).
Lina: I turned PREFETCH_WINDOW=2 in the sample env and redeployed to staging. Staging looks good so far.
ops-bot: deploy-staging succeeded for starter-app @ 2026-07-21T11:02:10Z
Priya (devex): Also saw some 401s mixed in because some requests retried before the refresh completed. That explains the auth cascade.
Omar (sdk): Pseudocode for refresh coalesce:
```
lock = locks.get(cred_id)
await lock.acquire()
try:
  if token_expired():
    token = await refresh_token()
finally:
  lock.release()
# callers wait for lock if refresh in progress
```
Omar (sdk): For 429 handling:
```
retry_after = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 0))
sleep(max(base_backoff * 2**attempt, retry_after))
```
Ruth (platform): We can also surface X-RI-Quota to clients; add guidance in the header docs and maybe a small edge smoothing token-bucket for UI-origin bursts while SDK patches roll out.
Priya (devex): Let's add onboarding docs: "If on trial, set PREFETCH_WINDOW<=2, PREFETCH_ON_RESUME=false, upgrade SDKs for auth coalescing." Include a sample env snippet and note about idempotency keys for prefetch endpoints.
Lina: Any billing risk from duplicate retries? If a retry succeeds after the original succeeded, could inflate token usage.
Ruth (platform): Yes — duplicates can increase usage counts. Recommend idempotency keys on prefetch (client generated) and server dedupe on idempotent endpoints where possible. We'll add that to the migration guide.
Omar (sdk): Action items: - Implement auth coalesce in python & go SDKs (ETA 6h) - Make SDKs parse X-RI-Quota and flip to conservative mode when remaining<=3 (ETA 4h) - Respect Retry-After header (ETA 1h) - Add dev-mode warning log when low quota (ETA 2h).
Ruth (platform): Platform actions: - temporary edge smoothing for trial bucket (ETA 2h) - document X-RI-Quota/X-RI-Reset headers in client integration docs (ETA 5h) - consider idempotency support for prefetch endpoints (longer term).
Priya (devex): I'll update sample app readme + onboarding quickstart with the PREFETCH env vars and a short troubleshooting checklist.
Lina: I've toggled PREFETCH_ON_RESUME=false for mobile trials and set PREFETCH_WINDOW=1 for trial web cohort. Will monitor.
ops-bot: alert: staging smoke tests passed @ 2026-07-21T11:18:45Z
Omar (sdk): I'll open PRs and tag @Ruth and @Priya for review. Will include unit tests for concurrent refresh + integration test simulating X-RI-Quota low + 429.
Lina: Thanks all — ping here if residual 429s after rollout. :thumbsup:
